title: EquiBench: Benchmarking Large Language Models’ Reasoning about Program Semantics via Equivalence Checking

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model accuracy separately on equivalent and inequivalent program pairs to measure the false negative rate. The analysis reveals a bias where models heavily rely on surface-level syntactic similarity, disproportionately misclassifying structurally different but semantically equivalent programs (such as in CUDA and x86-64 categories) as inequivalent.
